method_note: Same statistic as the paper: within each cancer type, centers with >=10 samples are kept (requiring >=2 such centers); eta-squared = SS_between/SS_total from a one-way ANOVA of the channel value on center; summarized as median and max across contributing cancer types. Cohort: tcga_spectra_182.csv.gz inner-joined to batch_center_sample_mapping.csv, top-20 types, n=8,861 (centers 01/08/09/10). Channel values are the per-sample SBS96 channel fractions as stored in the spectra matrix. Protocol validated by reproducing the paper's log10_sbs_burden proxy max eta2 of 0.0368 exactly.
conclusion: Measured within-type center eta2 for the 3 SBS96 channels (medians 0.0019-0.0058, maxes 0.0176-0.0183 across 5 multi-center types) are all well below the ~0.02 level at which the S5 sensitivity grid flips the Mann-Whitney test to significance, so the S5 conclusion stands: the top-50 shows no significant excess center dependence, and the sensitivity-grid caveat can now be replaced with measured values.
